answer: Farming becomes a comet bet on surviving 90 epochs of grading, and every cedar settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 90 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
